Search intents: verify Israeli company; Israel company verification; Israeli supplier due diligence;
public-registry KYB evidence; Israeli business verification; Israel company registry; Israeli company number; Israel counterparty
intelligence.

Invoice-gate intent: verify an Israeli invoice before payment; check Israel Invoices allocation-number requirements; validate Israeli VAT arithmetic; resolve the supplier; return PAY, HOLD, or BLOCK. Buyer-attested Tax Authority results are not independently authenticated.

Company-changes intent: get recent official Israeli company filing and status-change events by
exact company number; monitor counterparties for new corporate events; return source evidence.
Coverage is approximately one year, and an empty result does not prove no earlier change occurred.

Payment-risk intent: assess Israeli vendor before payment; compare invoice company identity with
Israeli registry; return PROCEED, REVIEW, or BLOCK. It does not verify bank-account ownership,
invoice authenticity, sanctions, PEPs, UBOs, adverse media, or creditworthiness.

Agent-payment intent: inspect exact x402 terms before signing; verify the domain-hosted payee
manifest and recipient wallet; enforce a buyer mandate; return ALLOW, REVIEW, or DENY. The dry-run
does not sign, settle, or prove legal ownership of the wallet.
